cues: Changes in number come in two kinds.
Aneuploidy changes one or a few chromosomes, and it starts with non disjunction: a pair fails to separate at anaphase, so one gamete gets an extra chromosome and the other gets none.
text: Changes in number come in two kinds. Euploidy changes whole sets. Aneuploidy changes one or a few chromosomes, and it starts with non disjunction: a pair fails to separate at anaphase, so one gamete gets an extra chromosome and the other gets none.
